turns.text: So you're queuing up, someone sat at the till and they go, ‘That'll be thirty dollars for the buffet!’ and I said, ‘Thank you very much,’ handed my card over and then she said, ‘You can add your tip now!’ I said, ‘Can I?!’ Because I… Did you?
turns.zh: 所以你在排队，有人坐在收银台那儿，然后她说：‘自助餐三十美元！’我就说：‘非常感谢，’把卡递过去，然后她说：‘你现在可以加小费了！’我说：‘我可以吗？！’因为我……你呢？

turns.text: And I know that all those Americans hated me but it's just mental, I'm literally at a buffet, I do the work myself and they want me to tip.
turns.zh: 我知道那些美国人肯定都讨厌我，但这简直太离谱了，我明明就在自助餐厅，我自己动手拿吃的，他们还想让我给小费。

turns.text: But they have to because they they pay American servers like pittance, they pay them so little because they know they're going to get loads of tips, isn't that mental?
turns.zh: 但他们不得不这样，因为他们付给美国服务员那点钱少得可怜，他们给得那么少，是因为他们知道服务员会拿到很多小费，这不离谱吗？

turns.text: Do they get loads of tips?
turns.zh: 他们会拿到很多小费吗？

turns.text: Yeah because Americans have such a tipping culture put into them, because they know that the servers don't get a lot so they have to, otherwise it's rude.
turns.zh: 是啊，因为美国人骨子里就有这种小费文化，因为他们知道服务员拿不到多少钱，所以他们必须给，不然就是没礼貌。
